Our Leadership

Leadership

Chimezie Micheal Lawrence

CEO & Founder

An Economics graduate of the University of Port Harcourt, Chimezie brings experience in real estate development, construction materials supply and residential project delivery. His leadership focuses on cost awareness, responsible growth and turning development plans into lasting value.

Michelle Lawrence

Chief Operating Officer

Michelle brings experience in international sourcing, supplier coordination and customer relationships. Her sourcing career began in Turkey in 2017 and expanded into China procurement and automobiles. A Mass Communication graduate of Imo State University, she focuses on dependable service and operational efficiency.
